newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha easy, looking to gasoline for direction.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha easy, looking to gasoline for direction.

text.p: NWE spot and paper naphtha rices remained easy on Friday and traders said despite early crude gains, thin buying and good avails kept the pressure on prices.
"Sellers' levels continue to drift lower but are still failing to attract fresh buying interest," one trader said. "I think people are waiting to see if gasoline prices pick up."

Gasoline eased on Wednesday after bearish API U.S. stock data and demand forecasts, but naphtha losses have outpaced those of gasoline with ample refinery supply in ARA and slack petrochemical demand taking the naphtha/gasoline spread out to around $15 a tonne.
Barges prices talked in a wider range around $174-$177.
Cargo sellers eased offers a couple of dollars but a dearth of buying interest left the market notional around $173/$178 cif NWE with May paper at a similar level.
